hypotheses.cause: The recommendations-api Deployment specifies a hard pod anti-affinity rule (requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution) with topologyKey kubernetes.io/hostname, making replica pods mutually exclusive per node. Because there is only one available worker node (vm-4) and it already hosts a matching replica (recommendations-api-599d96d7cd-c2c4x), the second replica (recommendations-api-599d96d7cd-77tpb) remains permanently unschedulable in Pending phase.

Pod recommendations-api-599d96d7cd-c2c4x is running on node vm-4 with label app.kubernetes.io/name=recommendations-api, satisfying and blocking the anti-affinity constraint for that node.

hypotheses.cause: Pod recommendations-api-599d96d7cd-77tpb is unschedulable due to compute resource exhaustion (insufficient CPU or Memory allocatable capacity on worker nodes).
contradicts: Node vm-4 has 4 CPU and 16374180Ki memory allocatable with condition MemoryPressure=False.

supports: Pod recommendations-api-599d96d7cd-77tpb specifies CPU requests of 20m and memory requests of 16Mi.

hypotheses.cause: Pod recommendations-api-599d96d7cd-77tpb is unschedulable due to un-tolerated node taints or node cordoning preventing pod placement on candidate nodes.
contradicts: Node vm-4 scheduled and executed pod recommendations-api-599d96d7cd-c2c4x without taint restrictions blocking it.

payload.rationale: The recommendations-api Deployment specifies hard pod anti-affinity (requiredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution) with topologyKey kubernetes.io/hostname. With only one available worker node (vm-4), the second replica cannot be scheduled and remains Pending. Converting the hard anti-affinity rule to a soft preference (preferredDuringSchedulingIgnoredDuringExecution) allows both replicas to be scheduled on the single node while preserving best-effort spreading when additional nodes become available.
